title: Department of State AIRGRAM: Sighting of Object Possibly Originating from Space Vehicle, May 18, 1966
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State airgram from the American Embassy in Tokyo regarding a press report of a UAP sighting in Nemuro, Japan, and questioning the necessity of reporting such dubious events.

incidents.summary: Observation of an unidentified object near Nemuro, Japan, as reported in the Yomiuri newspaper.
incidents.explanation: The embassy notes the validity of the observations seems dubious.
incidents.quote: no other papers have discussed the Nemuro observations
